description: Cases every implementation of nemar.sensor-field.v1 reproduces. Each case gives sensors (name, theta_deg, radius, value; null is a value that is not finite) and either the expected map or the word it is refused with. z[i][j] is the value at (x[i], y[j]); null is a masked cell. Sensor indices are input rows from 0; merged lists each merge group, the kept sensor first. The expected maps are eegprep's topoplot of the merged, finite sensors. A case whose sensors give x, y and z instead of theta_deg and radius places them by 3D positions in the frame coordinate_system names (or n/a with a montage): nemar.sensor-layout.v1 projects them (expected.layout, compared as in sensor-layout.v1.json), then the map is drawn; frame_unknown is the projection's refusal.

cases.name: montage_32
cases.description: 32 sensors of eegprep's egi-gsn-hydrocell-32.sfp (CapTrak frame), laid out by nemar.sensor-layout.v1, with a smooth field plus noise.

cases.name: montage_64
cases.description: 64 sensors of eegprep's egi-gsn-65-v2.sfp (CapTrak frame), laid out by nemar.sensor-layout.v1, with a smooth field plus noise.

cases.name: montage_128
cases.description: 128 sensors of eegprep's biosemi-128.locs (CapTrak frame), laid out by nemar.sensor-layout.v1, with a smooth field plus noise.

cases.name: montage_256
cases.description: 256 sensors of eegprep's egi-gsn-hydrocell-257.locs (EEGLAB frame), laid out by nemar.sensor-layout.v1, with a smooth field plus noise.

cases.name: exact_duplicates
cases.description: montage_32 plus three sensors at the exact layout position of an earlier one (two at row 4, one at row 17) with different values: the merged sensor carries the mean.

cases.name: near_duplicates
cases.description: montage_32 plus a sensor 4e-4 from row 6 and one 9e-4 from row 20 (raw layout units): within the merge distance, so each merges into the earlier sensor and the reference is eegprep on the merged inputs.

cases.name: close_pair
cases.description: montage_32 plus a sensor 1.5e-3 from row 9 (raw layout units): beyond the merge distance, so both are interpolated.

cases.name: collinear_midline
cases.description: Eight sensors on the midline only (theta 0 and 180): every sensor is collinear.

cases.name: outside
cases.description: montage_32 plus a sensor behind the head at radius 1.2 (x = -1.2: inside the square, which has no absolute value, so it is interpolated and widens the grid), one at theta 0 radius 1.1 (x = 1.1 > intrad: not interpolated, not plotted) and one at theta -90 radius 1.05 (y = -1.05: interpolated).

cases.name: nan_values
cases.description: montage_32 with the values of rows 3, 11 and 27 not finite (NaN, +Infinity, -Infinity; written null here): those sensors are dropped.

cases.name: nan_positions
cases.description: montage_32 with row 8's theta and row 15's radius not finite (written null): those sensors are dropped.

cases.name: constant_values
cases.description: montage_32 with every value 2.5: the biharmonic interpolant of equal values is not constant (it has no constant term), as in EEGLAB.

cases.name: zero_map
cases.description: montage_32 with every value 0: a constant map, drawn in one color with no contours.

cases.name: three_sensors
cases.description: Exactly three sensors: the fewest that draw a map.

cases.name: two_sensors
cases.description: Two sensors: refused.

cases.name: merged_to_two
cases.description: Three sensors, two at one position: two remain after the merge, so the map is refused.

cases.name: dynamic_range
cases.description: montage_32 with magnitudes from 1e-3 to 1e3 (a dynamic range of 1e6) and mixed signs.

cases.name: far_sensor
cases.description: montage_32 plus a sensor at theta -135 and radius 1e10: it is interpolated (x and y are far below intrad), and it stretches the grid so far that no cell lies inside the head, so the map is refused.

cases.name: overflow
cases.description: montage_32 with values of magnitude 1e308: the interpolation overflows binary64, so the map is refused.

cases.name: boundary_ties
cases.description: montage_32 plus three sensors on exact ties: EDGE at theta 0, radius 1.0 (the largest radius, so plotrad = intrad = 1.0, and x = 1.0 = intrad: plotted and interpolated, because both tests are <=), and NEAR at theta 0, radius 1e-3, exactly 1e-3 from ORIGIN at radius 0 (merged, because the merge test is <=).

cases.name: merged_outermost
cases.description: montage_32 plus a sensor 5e-4 outside row 28, the outermost: it merges into that sensor, and the radii come from every usable sensor before the merge (EEGLAB), so from it. The reference passes eegprep that plotrad, since eegprep sees only the merged sensors.

cases.name: negative_extreme
cases.description: montage_128 with a field whose most negative value is larger in magnitude than its most positive, so absmax differs from max.

cases.name: positions_measured
cases.description: Measured positions: 64 sensors of eegprep's GSN 65 cap in centimeters (CapTrak), row 10 without a finite x (written null; that sensor is dropped). They are projected by nemar.sensor-layout.v1 (expected.layout), and the projected layout is drawn.

cases.name: positions_template
cases.description: Template positions: every electrode of the montage GSN-HydroCel-32 (RAS meters) with the coordinate system n/a, projected about the montage's own center.

cases.name: positions_template_midline
cases.description: Template positions: the nine midline electrodes of standard_1005, Fpz to Oz, with n/a. Projected about the montage's own center, they lie along the line from the nose to the back of the head, as on the full cap, and the map is drawn.

cases.name: positions_frame_unknown
cases.description: The same positions in the coordinate system Other: the projection is refused, and a renderer places the sensors by name instead.

cases.name: positions_flat_disk
cases.description: Thirty-two positions on a disk in the plane z = 0 (EEGLAB): flat, so the projection is refused (positions_flat), and a renderer places the sensors by name instead.

cases.name: positions_three
cases.description: Three positions: refused (positions_flat).

cases.name: positions_ring
cases.description: Nine measured positions on one tilted circle (EEGLAB): in one plane, so they fix no head; the projection is refused (positions_flat), and a renderer places the sensors by name instead.

cases.name: positions_montage_beside_a_frame
cases.description: Template positions that name a montage and also CapTrak: inconsistent, so refused, never guessed.
